user.description: Choose a device to set up

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress

init.title: Magic Caster Wand Configuration
init.description: Configure the TFLite server URL for spell detection and spell timeout.

data_description.spell_timeout: Time in seconds before a detected spell resets to awaiting. Set to 0 to disable timeout.

vibrate.name: Vibrate Wand
vibrate.description: Vibrate the wand. A single command produces a fixed pulse of about 800 ms, regardless of the requested duration.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Requested vibration duration in milliseconds. Closely spaced commands may extend the firmware pulse.

set_led.name: Set LED
set_led.description: Set the color of a specific LED group on the wand.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Light duration in milliseconds. Use 0 for permanent.

send_macro.name: Send Macro
send_macro.description: Send a sequence of macro commands to a wand or box. Commands run in order and can change LEDs, wait, vibrate, and define loops. The box has one LED group (TIP) and no vibration motor.

commands.name: Macro Commands
commands.description: A list of command objects. Supported keys: changeled (group, rgb, duration), clear, delay (delay), buzz (buzz), set_loops (1–255), loop, and wait. LED groups: TIP, MID_UPPER, MID_LOWER, POMMEL (or 0–3). RGB channels range from 0 to 255; duration is in milliseconds.

clear_leds.name: Clear LEDs
clear_leds.description: Turn off all LEDs on the wand.

play_spell.name: Play Spell Effect
play_spell.description: Play a predefined spell macro effect.
